deviations.title: Encoding is TanStack JSON default, NOT repeated params
deviations.severity: deviation from an approved Gate-1 decision
deviations.detail: Gate 1 chose repeated params. main.tsx sets no stringifySearch, so writes emit ?status=%5B%22todo%22%5D. incidents.title: Scratch-backup basename collision
incidents.detail: During the first tier-2 mutation check, kanban-board/index.tsx and list-view/index.tsx both backed up to index.tsx.FIXED; the restore put list-view content into kanban-board/index.tsx. Caught immediately by an identity grep (expandedSections), repaired from git HEAD, edits re-applied, fully re-verified. Second mutation run used full-path-derived backup names. No residue.

incidents.title: F1 first implementation was wrong and its own new test caught it
incidents.detail: The sync-down effect ran after the localStorage restore had queued its update, so prev was the restored value and an empty URL wiped it, breaking AC-3. Fixed by skipping the effect first invocation. Evidence in evidence/ac7-mutation-check.txt.

incidents.title: validateBoardSearch threw on null
incidents.detail: Introduced during refinement; caught by the new AC-5 test in the same batch. search.taskId was read before any object guard. Fixed.

incidents.title: Flash emitted a stray CJK character
incidents.detail: tp_p6_guard output contained `useUserPreferencesStore: () => ({ 首`. Caught on read before writing; corrected.

estimator_note: auth_mode=estimated. Flash events carry vendor-reported tokens (provenance: vendor). Opus events are estimated (provenance: estimated); subagent phases derive input as reported subagent total minus char-estimated output, so they include per-turn context re-sends, whereas the orchestrators own in-session phases use chars/3.8 on fresh content only and exclude conversational re-sends. The two are therefore not strictly comparable and the Opus figure is a floor, not a measurement.

most_instructive_event.what: The Gate-3 URL-authoritative fix was wrong on the first attempt and its own new test caught it.
most_instructive_event.evidence: x still restores from localStorage when the URL carries no filters -- Expected: ["label-bug"], Received: null
most_instructive_event.cause: The sync-down effect runs after the localStorage-restore effect has queued its update, so the functional updater's `prev` was the restored filters, not the all-null default. With an empty URL the match check failed and it overwrote the restore with defaults, breaking AC-3.
most_instructive_event.fix: hasSyncedFromUrlRef skips the effect's first invocation.
most_instructive_event.lesson: The stated reasoning was plausible and wrong. Only the test distinguished them.
